name: laywill-github-io
description: v1 of williamlay.co.uk. A 2017 HTML5 UP 'Story' template, hand-edited since. There is no bundler and no framework: the HTML is served as authored, and the only build step is compiling assets/sass/ to assets/css/main.css.

scripts.css:check: npm run css && git diff --exit-code -- assets/css/main.css
